title: regen-asm.sh fallback path passes duplicate --out-dir to cargo rustc
description:
The `REGEN_ASM_FALLBACK=1` path of `dev/scripts/regen-asm.sh` invokes `cargo rustc --release -p $crate --lib -- --emit=asm --out-dir $tmp ...`, but `cargo rustc` already injects its own `--out-dir`. The duplicate triggers `error: Option 'out-dir' given more than once`.

## Background

Discovered out-of-scope during c3a9a4cb R1 review (commit `3ccc023`). The R1 worker correctly declined to fix it without lead approval, since the rework brief explicitly limited scope to the two reviewer-cited findings.

The bug only affects the documented fallback path (`REGEN_ASM_FALLBACK=1`); the primary `cargo-show-asm` path is unaffected. The fallback is a defense-in-depth feature — it's documented as the workaround when `cargo install cargo-show-asm` fails (network/permissions). On the dev host, `cargo-show-asm` is installed (was installed during c3a9a4cb R0), so the fallback is unused in normal operation.

## Reproduction

```bash
# Hide cargo-show-asm to force the fallback
PATH="/tmp/sandbox_bin:..." TARGET_CPU="" REGEN_ASM_FALLBACK=1 \
  ./dev/scripts/regen-asm.sh gf2-kernels-simd \
  gf2_kernels_simd::x86::avx2::avx2_xor_into /tmp/test_fallback.txt
# fails with: error: Option 'out-dir' given more than once
```

## Fix sketch

Either:
- Drop the `--out-dir $tmp` flag entirely; let cargo write to its default target dir, then locate and copy the emitted .s file from `target/release/deps/`. OR
- Use `cargo rustc --target-dir $tmp --release ...` to redirect cargo's own output dir.

The first is simpler; the second avoids polluting the caller's target dir.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] `REGEN_ASM_FALLBACK=1 ./dev/scripts/regen-asm.sh ...` succeeds end-to-end (produces a populated artefact file with valid asm content) when `cargo-show-asm` is unavailable.
- [hard] No regression on the primary `cargo-show-asm` path (existing tests still produce valid artefacts).
- [hard] Add a smoke test or shellcheck-time assertion (or at least a comment explaining the chosen pattern) so future edits don't re-introduce the dup-flag.

## Non-goals

- Not introducing automated CI for the fallback path — `cargo-show-asm` is the documented primary path, and the fallback is opt-in.

## Notes

This is a small follow-up to c3a9a4cb (commit `3ccc023`). Probably fits in one R0 cycle.
